verdict.rationale: Exa has an API reference with request examples: the search reference page shows a curl call and a response schema. Its homepage links an "API Playground", and OpenAPI specs can be downloaded, which together suggest an interactive, runnable reference. However, the evidence for interactivity is just a single "API Playground" label; nothing describes a try-it-in-browser reference. The one hands-on report of a broken "Get Code" cURL concerns the separate Websets UI, not the API reference. missing for 10: documentation that the reference pages themselves let you run requests in-browser, detail on what the API Playground does, independent hands-on corroboration of runnable examples.
